current_evidence_basis: Cirsium demographic-transmission synthesis: 0/5 broad abiotic comparisons support a general monotonic productivity/fertility/elevation moderator; full interaction models outperform environment-only
why_more_generic_meta_will_not_resolve_i: More broad-correlative climate papers cannot distinguish direct abiotic action from interaction/demographic mediation
decisive_next_data: No generic new analysis required; retain head-scale microclimate only as a mechanistic covariate in focal experiments
new_literature_reopens_gate_if: Replicated Cirsium experiment manipulates an abiotic variable and shows reproducible switching of the same trait->interaction->fitness path

current_evidence_basis: 6-study/4-taxon Cirsium demographic-transmission synthesis: seed effects transmit consistently in 4, context-dependently in 1, are blocked in 1; explicit demographic gates supported in 3/4 tests
why_more_generic_meta_will_not_resolve_i: Cross-study recruitment/IPM estimands are heterogeneous and already show the predicted switch; more generic studies will not tell which focal populations are seed-limited vs safe-site-limited
decisive_next_data: Conditional seed-addition x microsite/disturbance pilot only after a focal seed-output contrast is demonstrated
new_literature_reopens_gate_if: A new Cirsium factorial study provides common-scale seed output and recruitment responses across manipulated microsite or density contexts

current_evidence_basis: 6 independent Cirsium studies: high pollinator dependence is common, but dependence is not equivalent to open pollen limitation; assurance varies with selfing, donor spacing, synchrony and local density
why_more_generic_meta_will_not_resolve_i: Available designs already establish the decoupling; more heterogeneous visitation or bagging reports cannot classify focal assurance
decisive_next_data: Nested bagged/open/supplemented comparison plus donor distance, flowering overlap, local density, effective contacts and final seed fitness
new_literature_reopens_gate_if: At least three new independent Cirsium studies report the same supplement-vs-open seed-output estimand with uncertainty, enabling a formal pooled effect

current_evidence_basis: Strict five-program multi-agent manipulation synthesis: antagonist-dominant 2, pollinator-dominant 1, mixed/no-fixed dominance 2; >=2 categories remain under every leave-one-program-out; restricted 6-article pollinator-gradient meta shows broad trait class and interaction intensity alone do not identify trait-specific selection
why_more_generic_meta_will_not_resolve_i: The general mosaic architecture is now falsification-supported, but cross-species meta-analysis cannot tell which agent dominates a focal Cirsium population or which capitulum trait has local leverage
decisive_next_data: Same-population pollination supplementation x post-anthesis antagonist protection on one seed-fitness scale, plus trait->effective-contact and trait->damage slopes
new_literature_reopens_gate_if: New factorial floral-selection studies substantially expand the strict dual-manipulation set and overturn the current leave-one-program-out heterogeneity

current_evidence_basis: Trade-off-mitigation review documents temporal/spatial/sensory strategies; Cirsium arvense scent timing is consistent with pollinator/florivore partitioning; external orientation studies show time-window/abiotic benefits; Opuntia shows temporal partitioning can coexist with residual pollination costs
why_more_generic_meta_will_not_resolve_i: Direct studies that manipulate the putative partitioning trait and simultaneously close mutualist, antagonist and final-fitness paths are too heterogeneous/sparse for a common meta-effect; suggestive examples and counterexamples cannot identify causal mitigation in Cirsium
decisive_next_data: Orientation manipulation with early/mid/late effective contacts, microclimate/wetting/pollen viability, antagonist exposure and final achenes; total all-day visitation may remain unchanged
new_literature_reopens_gate_if: At least five independent comparable manipulations quantify partitioning trait -> both visitor channels -> reproductive fitness on a harmonizable scale

current_evidence_basis: Azami shows weak cross-module coupling and one structural screen favours modular models, but robust held-out screening leaves common-lability nearly tied and it produced the only 11/11 core draw
why_more_generic_meta_will_not_resolve_i: Cross-study meta-analysis cannot establish within-radiation covariance of module-specific causal paths because studies measure different traits, taxa, interaction channels and ancestry backgrounds
decisive_next_data: Ancestry-controlled multivariate focal data comparing one shared latent/common-lability structure against module-specific trait->interaction/protection->fitness paths with out-of-sample validation
new_literature_reopens_gate_if: A large multi-trait within-species/radiation dataset measures homologous modules, interactions and fitness jointly across replicated populations
